name: Search traffic
ownerWords:
not bad, but our DR is probably shit, we aint getting any visitors. can you have a meta-level goal and subgoals?

our goal is 10,000 blog/tool visits/day, and 300 sign ups from that. 

so you manage Search keyword research, competitor SEO analysis, like posting things on reddit, marketing forums ... to boost our DR, managing analytics and conversion realted to the initial land somewhere -> landing page/product page -> sign up or book a call flow

(10-18) things are meant to be first written in plan -> achieved ->  cleared & written on duty for maintanence only -> and valiantly persued whenever not met. JUST DO IT
goal: Pages that already get Google impressions keep them, every blog change on the local sieun/dev tip reaches GitHub sieun/dev within a day, no article carries copy brief.md bans, and the PostHog, Search Console, Clerk and git reads keep working. The visits, clicks and sign-up numbers are detail lines that feed plan goals p56 and p71, and they never make this duty miss. These four metrics hold the faults that came back in this chat: pages that lost their Google impressions after an edit (3 pages on 10-13, missed 3 runs), blog work left uncommitted or waiting for a push (seen on 9 days from 10-08 to 10-18), copy with the wrong creator count or a no-card claim (the owner corrected it on 10-12), and data reads that broke (source_errors missed 4 of 12 runs: uv not found, the Search Console key path, a Google 500 and a PostHog 503).

metrics.label: Pages that had 5+ Google impressions a day in the 14 days before the last 3 final days and fell under 20% of that in those 3 days, counting a new page from its first day (Search Console)
apps/blog commits on the local sieun/dev tip that are not on GitHub sieun/dev 24 h after their commit
apps/blog/content pages on sieun/dev with copy brief.md bans: a creator count other than 180M+, "no credit card" or free search
Data sources that failed or were stale (PostHog, Search Console, Clerk, git)

onMiss: Every run works in auto-sns-agent's SEO program (apps/llm-wiki/content/sessions/2026/10/02/0040-virev-seo-agent/program), under its brief.md rules. Run `uv run --project scripts/seo seo-goal` and `seo gsc pull` to save the day. First write the detail numbers into the plan with plan_update: goal_visits_d7 into the current value of goal p56's target, signups_goal_d28 into p71's, and google_clicks_d7 into the target of the p56 step that tracks Google clicks when one does. Then each missed metric gets one fix step under p56 with duty "d1/<metric key>" and a live job. dropped_pages finds why each listed page lost its impressions (index status, a redirect, a canonical, a ranking loss) and ships the fix. unshipped_blog_changes gets the listed commits onto GitHub sieun/dev and fixes what held them back. banned_copy removes the copy from each listed page and lands it. source_errors fixes the read this run, or goes to a "seo sources fix" step. A step whose job is live (agent_observe.list_agents) gets the new numbers and flagged lines by message; a step with no live job gets one with await rlm.create_session(brief, name=...), and the step's job is set to it. Never start a second copy. Its brief names the metric, value and target and the pages, articles or commits in the detail, and asks for shipped changes. Never end a run with a missed metric and no live fix job. SEO crawl, indexing and performance fixes to live apps/search pages and the owner-approved tool pages land under c74 (owner yes 10-19); new apps/search features and design changes stay parked until the owner says the 5180 demo is good enough (c40). Nothing goes outside (c37), and prod promotes need no ask (c74). Tell the owner the four duty numbers, the three plan numbers and what shipped.
